 Richard Riehle , the veteran actor known for his roles in Office Space and Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo , has sadly passed away at 78.
 The actor died on Thursday (October 15) in Los Angeles, according to TMZ , which reported the news on Monday (October 19).
 Friends of Richard told the outlet that he died of natural causes.
 What Was Richard Riehle Known For?
 Richard had a lengthy career in Hollywood, appearing in more than 400 film and television projects according to his IMDb credits.
 He was perhaps best known for playing Tom Smykowski in the 1999 comedy Office Space , directed by Mike Judge .
 His character works at the fictional technology company Initech before being laid off. After surviving a traffic accident, Tom receives a large settlement and uses the money to pursue his idea for a “Jump to Conclusions” mat.
 The character became a fan favorite thanks to his memorable scenes in the cult comedy, which also starred Ron Livingston , Jennifer Aniston and Gary Cole .
 Richard was also known for playing Walt Finnerty on the Fox sitcom Grounded for Life , which aired from 2001 to 2005.
 His other movie credits included The Fugitive , Casino , Fried Green Tomatoes , Of Mice and Men , Bridesmaids and Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo , in which he played Bob Bigalow, Deuce Bigalow’s father.
 On television, he appeared in shows including The West Wing , ER , NCIS , Modern Family and Boston Legal .
 He also appeared in multiple Star Trek series, including a memorable role as Batai in Star Trek: The Next Generation .
 Richard Riehle’s Long Career in Hollywood
 Born in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, in 1948, Richard studied at the University of Notre Dame before pursuing a career in acting.
 In addition to his work in film and television, he had an extensive theater career, appearing on Broadway in productions including Execution of Justice and The Iceman Cometh .
 One of his later credits was the 2024 Hallmark movie Holiday Touchdown: A Chiefs Love Story , starring Hunter King and Tyler Hynes .

 Richard also joined his co-stars at the movie’s Kansas City premiere , where he posed for photos alongside several other Hallmark actors.
 His career spanned decades, with roles in everything from major Hollywood movies to television comedies and independent films.
 Our thoughts are with Richard ‘s family and loved ones during this difficult time.
 We are remembering the stars who have sadly passed away in 2026.
